comments.author: @UntoldEarthDocs_Us
comments.text: It’s crazy how Fiji can look like absolute paradise to tourists while locals on remote islands may struggle just to get medicine, fuel, or building supplies. Makes you wonder: how much of the “island paradise” image do visitors actually see?

comments.author: @EpicEarthYTB
comments.text: Fiji is so much more than just postcard-perfect beaches. This video does an incredible job of showcasing the country's rich culture and complex reality beyond the resorts.

comments.author: @MrCuriousES1
comments.text: What stands out about Fiji is that the most interesting idea here has very little to do with beaches or resorts. 🇫🇯 Traditions built around sharing, village life, welcoming strangers and spending time together suggest a very different definition of prosperity. A community can have fewer material resources and still possess forms of social wealth that richer societies sometimes struggle to maintain.
